traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune, Pluto is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Imagination meets power. A deep generational signature: intensified collective imagination and transformation. Psychologically the square is inner tension to integrate: Collective illusion fused with destructive power. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.waxing: Crisis of action: take conscious hold and build a durable form for imagination against power, or be thrown off course.
cyclic.waning: Crisis of meaning: break down the imagination/power form that has outlived its purpose and reorient toward the next cycle.

business: Friction in this area. Generational and collective; minimal personal day-to-day meaning.
shadow: Illusion and escapism collides with control and obsession; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: Friction builds toward a forced adjustment.
arcSeparating: The crisis passes; what was restructured settles.
base: A belief can become harder to examine when accepting the power underneath it would force a painful revision of the story.

readerCopy.body: A belief can become harder to examine when accepting the power underneath it would force a painful revision of the story. When Neptune squares Pluto, hope, fear, loyalty, and idealism can make an unequal dynamic easier to justify because seeing the control clearly threatens what people want to believe. Scrutiny does not require distrusting everything that matters. The avoided question, the person who benefits, and the condition that suddenly becomes difficult to excuse often reveal where belief has started protecting power.
